The backends of `+curves::p256::keypair::sign_ecdsa; verify_ecdsa+`, `+to_der+`, `+from_der+`, `+normalize_ecdsa+`, `+check_low_s+`, from the test programs that run it:

[cols="1,2,2,4",options="header"]
|===
|Backend |Jamfile |Header |Targets

|BearSSL
|`+/third_party//bearssl+`
|`+<webcpp/crypto/backends/bearssl.hpp>+`
|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten (tested by `+p256_ecdsa_bearssl+`, `+p256_wycheproof_bearssl+`, `+p256_openssl_oracle+`, `+p256_webcrypto_oracle+`, `+allocation_bearssl+`)

|libsodium
|`+/third_party//sodium+`
|`+<webcpp/crypto/backends/sodium.hpp>+`
|refused at compile time (`+p256_on_sodium+`)
|===

A call that names no backend takes the family's default on each target, whatever the program links, as <<crypto-backends-defaults>> gives it with its reasons and tests:

[cols="1,1",options="header"]
|===
|Target |Default

|native, wasip2, wasip3, emscripten
|BearSSL
|===
